title: Tom and the Comic Strip
text:
Tom loves comic strips. Every Sunday he reads them in the newspaper. His favorite comic has a dog named Max. Max is very funny.

One day Tom draws his own comic strip. It has three boxes. In the last box, Max says hello to a cat. Tom shows it to his friend Lily, and she laughs.

questions.text: When does Tom read comic strips?
How many boxes does Tom's comic strip have?
How does Lily probably feel about Tom's comic strip?
What kind of person is Tom most likely?

vocabulary.definition: short stories told in a few drawn boxes
a set of printed pages with news, sold every day or every week
makes a sound because something is funny

paragraph_translations: Tom ama las tiras cómicas. Cada domingo las lee en el periódico. Su cómic favorito tiene un perro llamado Max. Max es muy gracioso.
Un día Tom dibuja su propia tira cómica. Tiene tres recuadros. En el último recuadro, Max saluda a un gato. Tom se la muestra a su amiga Lily, y ella se ríe.
